feature.chatter.label: Builders chat
Строители болтают
feature.chatter.desc: Builders now and then say a short line in the chat, like players: starting a house, waiting for your permission, red or green tests, a commit, a finished house, a coffee break, greeting each other. Rate-limited; quiet at night with real time.

Строители иногда пишут в чат короткую реплику, как игроки: начали дом, ждут твоего разрешения, тесты упали или позеленели, коммит, дом готов, перекур, здороваются друг с другом. Строгий лимит частоты; ночью при реальных сутках молчат.
param.chatterFrequency.label: Builder chat
Болтовня строителей
param.chatterFrequency.desc: How often builders say something in the chat.
Как часто строители пишут в чат.
chatter.wait.permission.1: Hey, I need your permission here.
chatter.wait.permission.2: Could you take a look? I can't go on without your OK.
Глянешь? Без твоего «да» дальше не могу.
chatter.wait.permission.3: Tools down until you say yes.
chatter.wait.question.1: I have a question for you, come over when you can.
У меня к тебе вопрос, загляни, как сможешь.
chatter.wait.question.2: Two ways to build this. Which one do you want?
Тут можно по-разному. Как тебе лучше?
chatter.tests.fail.2: One test is grumbling. Back to the drawing board.
Один тест ворчит. Возвращаюсь к чертежу.
chatter.tests.fail.3: That beam doesn't fit yet. Measuring again.
chatter.tests.failAgain.1: Third time red. A little rain cloud has moved in over my house.
Третий раз красные. Над домом уже тучка.
chatter.tests.failAgain.2: Still red. Coffee first, then I'll find it.
Опять красные. Сначала кофе, потом найду.
chatter.tests.green.3: Finally green. I'll ring the little bell.
chatter.commit.2: One more stone in the wall: commit done.
Ещё один камень в стену: коммит готов.
chatter.push.1: Pushed! The PostAuto is on its way.
chatter.push.2: Off it goes, down to the square.
chatter.pr.1: Pull request is up. New flag on the pole!
PR открыт. На флагштоке новый флаг!
chatter.apprentice.1: My apprentices are here. Let's go, team!
chatter.apprentice.2: Sending a little helper to scout ahead.
chatter.compact.1: Time for a coffee break, my head is full.
chatter.compact.2: Tidying up my notes, back in a moment.
chatter.limit.1: Thunder over the peaks. We wait a little.
chatter.limit.2: Too much traffic on the pass. Short break.
chatter.start.house.1: Starting on a new {what}. Good ground here.
chatter.start.house.3: A {what} it is. Where's my spirit level?
chatter.start.public.1: Now something for the whole district: {what}.
chatter.finish.house.2: House finished. Somebody fetch the alphorn!
chatter.finish.house.3: Last flower box in place. En Guete, new neighbours!
Последний ящик с цветами на месте. En Guete, новые соседи!
chatter.finish.stage.1: The house grew: stage {stage} is done.
chatter.finish.stage.2: Extension finished. More room for the family.
chatter.finish.public.2: Done for the district. Hopp Schwiiz!
chatter.renovate.1: Giving the old crew a hand with the repairs.
chatter.renovate.2: New plans for an old house. Careful with the beams!
Новые чертежи для старого дома. Осторожно с балками!
chatter.feierabend.2: Long day. Who's coming to the café?
Длинный день. Кто со мной в кафе?
chatter.morning.2: Fresh croissants at the bakery, I hear.
chatter.evening.1: The sun is behind the peak already.
chatter.evening.2: Lights are coming on in the valley.
chatter.rain.1: Rain again. Good for the geraniums.
chatter.banter.2: The clock tower is exactly on time. Of course.
Часы на башне идут секунда в секунду. Конечно.
chatter.banter.3: Somebody left a cow on the square again.
Кто-то опять оставил корову на площади.
chatter.banter.4: If the train is late, it's my fault.
Если поезд опоздает — это я виноват.
